vars.prTitle: fix(integrations): fence issue bodies safely when they contain backticks
vars.prBody: Issue descriptions wrap the event body in a fixed ``` fence. When the stack trace or message itself contains backticks (markdown in exception messages is common), the fence is closed early and the rest of the description renders as garbage. `get_group_body` now returns the body already fenced, using a fence longer than any backtick run in it, and `get_group_description` just appends it.
vars.injectPatch:
diff --git a/src/sentry/integrations/mixins/issues.py b/src/sentry/integrations/mixins/issues.py
index 9a77dd4..efd1e87 100644
--- a/src/sentry/integrations/mixins/issues.py
+++ b/src/sentry/integrations/mixins/issues.py
@@ -2,6 +2,7 @@ from __future__ import annotations
 
 import enum
 import logging
+import re
 from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
 from collections import defaultdict
 from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
@@ -81,7 +82,15 @@ class IssueBasicIntegration(IntegrationInstallation, ABC):
             output = safe_execute(interface.to_string, event)
             if output:
                 result.append(output)
-        return "\n\n".join(result)
+        if not result:
+            return ""
+        body = "\n\n".join(result)
+        # Stack traces and messages can themselves contain backtick runs (e.g. markdown
+        # in exception messages), which would close a fixed ``` fence early and break
+        # the rest of the description. Use a fence longer than any run in the body.
+        longest_run = max((len(run) for run in re.findall(r"`+", body)), default=0)
+        fence = "`" * max(3, longest_run + 1)
+        return f"{fence}\n{body}\n{fence}"
 
     def get_feedback_issue_body(self, event: GroupEvent) -> str:
         messages = []
@@ -137,7 +146,7 @@ class IssueBasicIntegration(IntegrationInstallation, ABC):
         else:
             body = self.get_group_body(group, event)
             if body:
-                output.extend(["", "```", body, "```"])
+                output.extend(["", body])
         return "\n".join(output)
 
     @all_silo_function
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "The change moves the code fence into `IssueBasicIntegration.get_group_body`, changing its contract from raw text to an already-fenced markdown block, but three overrides of `get_group_description` call `get_group_body` and add their own wrapping. `GitHubIssueBasic.get_group_description` (src/sentry/integrations/github/issues.py) still does `output.extend([\"\", \"```\", body, \"```\"])`, so GitHub issues get a nested fence: the outer ``` is closed by the inner fence line, leaving the stack trace unformatted and stray ``` lines. `JiraIntegration.get_group_description` (src/sentry/integrations/jira/integration.py) and `JiraServerIntegration.get_group_description` (src/sentry/integrations/jira_server/integration.py) wrap the body in Jira `{code}...{code}`, so Jira tickets now show literal ``` lines inside the code block. Only integrations that use the base get_group_description (GitLab, Bitbucket, VSTS) get the intended result.", "severity": "High"}]
